items.text: Lezi ziyizizukulwane zika-Aroni noMose ngosuku uJehova akhuluma ngalo kuMose entabeni yaseSinayi.
Lawa angamagama amadodana ka-Aroni; uNadabi izibulo, no-Abihu, no-Eleyazare, no-Itamari.
Lawa angamagama amadodana ka-Aroni, abapristi abagcotshiweyo, abamise ukuba bakhonze esikhundleni sobupristi.
ONadabi no-Abihu bafa phambi kukaJehova ekuletheni umlilo ongafanele phambi kukaJehova ehlane laseSinayi, bengenabantwana; u-Eleyazare no-Itamari bakhonza ebupristini phambi kwamehlo kayise u-Aroni.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Sondeza isizwe sakwaLevi, usimise phambi kuka-Aroni umpristi ukuba simkhonze.
Bayakugcina inkonzo yayo nenkonzo yebandla lonke phambi kwetende lokuhlangana, benze inkonzo yetende.
Kumelwe bagcine zonke izinto zetende lokuhlangana nenkonzo yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli ukuze benze umsebenzi wenkonzo yetende.
AmaLevi uyakuwanika u-Aroni namadodana akhe; baphiwa kuye besuka phakathi kwabantwana bakoIsrayeli.
Kumelwe umise u-Aroni namadodana akhe, futhi kumelwe balinde esikhundleni sabo sobupristi; futhi umfokazi osondelayo kumelwe abulawe.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Mina-ke, bheka, ngawathatha amaLevi phakathi kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli esikhundleni samazibulo onke avula isizalo phakathi kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli; ngalokho amaLevi ayakuba ngawami;
Ngoba wonke amazibulo angawami; ngokuba mhla ngibulala amazibulo onke ezweni laseGibithe, ngazingcwelisela kimi onke amazibulo akwa-Israyeli, abantu nawezilwane; bayakuba ngabami; nginguJehova.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose ehlane laseSinayi, wathi:
Bala abantwana bakwaLevi ngemindeni yabo ngezizukulwane zabo: bonke abesilisa kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu uyakubabala.
UMose wababala njengezwi likaJehova, njengalokho eyaliwe.
Lawa angamadodana kaLevi ngamagama awo; uGereshoni noKohati noMerari.
Lawa angamagama amadodana kaGereshoni ngemindeni yawo; uLibni noShimeyi.
Amadodana kaKohati ngemindeni yawo; u-Amramu no-Ishehari, uHebroni no-Uziyeli.
Amadodana kaMerari ngemindeni yawo; UMahli noMusi. Lezi ziyizizukulwane zamaLevi ngemindeni yawo.
KwaGereshoni kwavela umndeni wakwaLibini nomndeni wakwaSimi; lezi ziyizizukulwane zamaGereshoni.
Labo ababalwayo ngenani labo bonke abesilisa kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu, ababalwayo kubo babe yizinkulungwane eziyisikhombisa namakhulu amahlanu.
Imindeni yamaGereshoni kumelwe ikanise ngemva kwetabernakele ngasentshonalanga.
Isikhulu sendlu kayise wamaGereshoni siyakuba ngu-Eliyasafa indodana kaLayeli.
Inkonzo yamadodana kaGereshoni etendeni lokuhlangana iyakuba yitabernakele netende, nesembozo salo, neveli lomnyango wetende lokuhlangana;
nezilenge zegceke, nesilenge somnyango wegceke elingasetabernakele nase-altare nxazonke, nezintambo zalo zomsebenzi wonke walo.
KwaKohati kwavela umndeni wakwa-Amramu nomndeni wama-Ishari nomndeni wakwaHebroni nomndeni wakwa-Uzili; lezi ziyizizukulwane zamaKohati.
Ngokwenani labo bonke abesilisa kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu babe yizinkulungwane eziyisishiyagalombili namakhulu ayisithupha ababegcina inkonzo yendlu engcwele.
Imindeni yamadodana kaKohati iyakumisa eceleni kwetabernakele ngaseningizimu.
Isikhulu sendlu kayise wemindeni yamaKohati siyakuba ngu-Elishafani indodana ka-Uziyeli.
Inkonzo yabo iyakuba ngumphongolo, netafula, nothi lwesibani, nama-altare, nezinto zendlu engcwele abakhonza ngazo, neveli, nayo yonke inkonzo yalo.
U-Eleyazare, indodana ka-Aroni umpristi, kumelwe abe induna yezikhulu zamaLevi, aqondise labo abagcina inkonzo yendlu engcwele.
KwaMerari kwavela umndeni wakwaMagili nomndeni wamaMushi; lezi ziyizizukulwane zikaMerari.
Labo ababalwayo ngenani labo bonke abesilisa kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu babe yizinkulungwane eziyisithupha namakhulu amabili.
Isikhulu sendlu kayise wemindeni yakwaMerari sasinguSuriyeli indodana ka-Abihayili; kumelwe bakanise ohlangothini lwetabernakele, olubheke enyakatho.

Ngaphansi kwesandla sokuqondisa nokuqondisa kwamadodana kaMerari kuyakuba khona izinsika zetabernakele, nemishayo yalo, nezinsika zalo, nezisekelo zalo, nazo zonke izinto zalo, nakho konke okukhonza kulo;
nezinsika zegceke nxazonke, nezinyawo zazo, nezikhonkwane zazo, nezintambo zazo.

Abamisa phambi kwetabernakele ngasempumalanga phambi kwetende lokuhlangana ngasempumalanga, bayakuba ngoMose no-Aroni namadodana akhe abagcina inkonzo yendlu engcwele enkonzweni yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli; futhi umfokazi osondelayo kumelwe abulawe.
Bonke ababalwayo bamaLevi uMose no-Aroni abababalayo ngokomyalo weNkosi ngezizukulwane zabo, bonke abesilisa kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu babe yizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nambili.
UJehova wathi kuMose: “Bala onke amazibulo abantwana babantwana bakwa-Israyeli kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu, uthabathe inani lamagama abo.
Kumelwe ungithathele amaLevi, nginguJehova, esikhundleni samazibulo onke phakathi kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli; nezinkomo zamaLevi esikhundleni samazibulo onke ezinkomo zabantwana bakwa-Israyeli.
UMose wabala onke amazibulo phakathi kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli, njengalokho uJehova emyalile.
Onke amazibulo esilisa ngenani lamagama, kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu, ababalwayo kubo, ayeyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nambili namakhulu amabili namashumi ayisithupha nantathu.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Thatha amaLevi esikhundleni samazibulo onke phakathi kwabantwana bakwa-Israyeli, nezinkomo zamaLevi esikhundleni sezinkomo zabo; amaLevi ayakuba ngawami. Mina nginguJehova.
Abazahlengwa kumazibulo angamakhulu amabili namashumi ayisithupha nantathu abantwana bakwa-Israyeli, abangaphezu kwamaLevi;
Kumelwe uthathe amashekeli amahlanu isigxobo ngasinye, ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele kumelwe uyithathe; (ishekeli lingamagera angamashumi amabili:)
Kumelwe uyinike u-Aroni namadodana akhe imali okufanele isibalo sabo esingavamile sihlengwe ngayo.
UMose wathatha imali yesihlengo kulabo ababengaphezu kwabahlengwe ngamaLevi.
Wayithatha imali kumazibulo abantwana bakwa-Israyeli; amashekeli ayinkulungwane namakhulu amathathu namashumi ayisithupha nanhlanu ngokweshekeli lendlu engcwele;
UMose wayinika u-Aroni namadodana akhe imali yesihlengo njengezwi likaJehova, njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
